entities.summary: August Konow was a performers & entertainers in Bergen (1780-10-19, Bergen – 1873-04-09), a notable figure of the Early Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
